title: 'Europe can, too, weaponise the economy and the single market', expert says

contentText: Speaking with FRANCE 24's Mark Owen, Grégoire Roos, Director of Europe, Russia and Eurasia programme at Chatham House, says that there is a 'convergence in messaging to Donald Trump' among EU leaders, who 'have bought time by, at last, taking the full measure of the power on which they have been sitting for so long, the single market and the dependencies that many around the world entertain vis-à-vis the single market'.
